title: Retrospective/oracle case manifest (manifest.json)
description: Top-level provenance and artifact-hash manifest written by `miner retrospective-export` at the root of a retrospective evidence directory. This is the miner's current 'oracle' bundle descriptor: it accompanies retrospective signals, commit relationships, materialized commits, and canonical patches used for evaluator/adjudication purposes, and it must never be supplied to a prospective reviewer or engine (docs/export-contract.md §7 risk 1, AGENTS.md architecture boundaries). Matches the unexported `manifest` struct in internal/retrospectiveexport/export.go exactly. No separate 'oracle-export' command exists yet; this schema documents the current retrospective-export manifest, which is the closest existing analog, pending a dedicated oracle-bundle command (docs/export-contract.md §9-§10 is silent on this; treat this schema as the current-behavior contract, not a target one).

input_file.description: Path to the correlated JSONL the record was selected from; provenance only, not portable across machines.

input_record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the selected record's exact source_record.json bytes.

repository_identity.description: original.repository from the selected record, when present.

repository_head.description: Local repository HEAD SHA at export time, when resolvable.

observation_end.description: Raw provenance.observation_end from the selected record, when present.

harvested_at.description: Raw provenance.harvested_at from the selected record, when present.

source_miner_provenance.description: The selected record's complete provenance block, copied verbatim.

files.description: Every artifact written under the retrospective case directory, sorted by path.
